title: The Red Miriok; Shan Folk Lore Stories
title_english: The Red Miriok; Shan Folk Lore Stories
title_as: ৰেড মিৰিয়ক: শ্বান (তাই) লোককথা আৰু নীতিশিক্ষা
author: Anna M. Barnes & Dr. W. C. Griggs
provenance: American Baptist Publication Society, Philadelphia; Library of Congress / Archive ID redmiriokshanfol0000anna
description: Authentic collection of Southwestern Tai (Shan) folk tales, Buddhist moral fables, and daily village traditions collected in the Shan States by Dr. W. C. Griggs, featuring the legendary Lord Sa Kyah (Sakka/Indra), pagoda festivals, and sacred monasteries.
